stats.notes: CDS C1 (fall 2024 entering class). VCU's 2025-2026 CDS was not posted on the IRDS Common Data Set page when checked, so this is the latest available. Residency split from the C1 residency table: in-state 17,109 / out-of-state 5,836 / international 797 / unknown 1,062 applicants; 15,171 / 4,401 / 596 / 601 admitted; 3,806 / 469 / 84 / 90 enrolled. The by-gender lines in C1 do not sum to these totals (CDS note: gender detail need not sum). Undergrad enrollment and nonresident count are the B1/B2 'Total Undergraduates' figures (21,210; 468 nonresidents). SAT/ACT percentiles cover only the 33.7% (1,442) / 3% (127) of enrollees who submitted scores. No early decision (C21); the admissions deadlines page lists only a Nov. 1 scholarship date and a Jan. 15 regular decision date.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8F (2024-25): test scores not required of freshman applicants over 22; test optional for some freshmen meeting criteria. The current admissions pages say all first-year applicants may apply test optional.
